message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, value-range guards, or structural validation are performed on the incoming image files or feature dataframes anywhere in the visible code.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded only from local filesystem paths; there are no remote fetches, and no checksum or integrity verification is performed on the cached pickle files or input images.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no code that validates label values against an expected set, compares label distributions, or uses any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The code performs no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs on training samples during data preparation.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads serialized models and pickle files (e.g., via pickle.load and keras load_model) without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to verify integrity.
No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, validates the expected label set, or detects anomalous training samples before training begins.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No backdoor or trigger detection mechanisms (e.g., neural cleanse, activation analysis, gradient anomaly detection) are present anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses scikit-learn's RandomForestRegressor with no differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) applied during training.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or any robustness stress testing anywhere in the evaluation pipeline.

No detected metric tampering protection: While a train/test split exists, there is no hashing or signing of evaluation data, no isolation guarantees enforced programmatically, and only a single metric (Pearson correlation / MSE) is used without independent verification.

No detected input sanitization: There are no input shape, range, or schema validation checks on the image paths or feature arrays before they are passed to the model; images are walked and processed without any guards.
No detected output bounds checks: After reg.predict() is called the predictions are stored and exported directly with no NaN guards, range checks, or sanity bounds on the regression outputs.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is not an LLM pipeline; it is a computer-vision regression system, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
